o.text:
Calque of Russian голосова́ть (golosovátʹ). Literally, “to give voice”.
Compare Turkmen ses bermek, Uzbek ovoz bermoq, Kazakh дауыс беру (dawıs berüw), and Kyrgyz добуш берүү (dobuş berüü), all with the same meaning from the same source.
